# OpenShell

> Preview of Docker driver from pimlock/openshell-driver-docker (PR #4, 147343b). Only this docset is built here; the rest is at https://pimlock.github.io/openshell-docs/llms.txt.

- [Docker Driver](/openshell-driver-docker/pr-4/drivers/docker/dev/setup.md): Run OpenShell sandboxes as containers on a local or remote Docker daemon.
- [Upgrade the Driver](/openshell-driver-docker/pr-4/drivers/docker/dev/upgrade.md): Move a gateway to a new Docker driver release without losing sandboxes.
